## User need

Describe who needs the change, what they are trying to accomplish, and why the
existing scope is insufficient.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result rather than prescribing an implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe one or more observable outcomes using Given-When-Then.

## Alternatives

Describe other approaches considered, if any.

## Impact

Identify related requirements and effects on accessibility, SCORM
compatibility, security, or LMS integration.

Do not include private learner data or confidential course content.
